title: Tensor Product Self-Duality
body_html:
Tensor Product Self-Duality

Under the identification \[ V^*\otimes_D V'^*\simeq (V\otimes_D V')^*, \] the dual norm of a tensor-product norm satisfies \[ (\ell\otimes\ell')^*=\ell^*\otimes\ell'^*. \] Consequently, if \(V\) and \(V'\) are formed spaces and \(L,L'\) are self-dual lattice functions, then \[ L\otimes L' \] is self-dual on \(V\otimes_DV'\).
proof_html: Choose bases splitting the two norms. The tensor-product basis splits the tensor norm, and the dual basis calculation gives the displayed identity. Translating the dual norms back through the sesquilinear forms gives \((\ell_L\otimes\ell_{L'})^\vee=\ell_L\otimes\ell_{L'}\), hence self-duality of the tensor-product lattice function.
